description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for checking read permissions on employee data groups within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It extends an abstract rule class and utilizes traits for authentication and user role management. The class constructor accepts a data group name, and the validate method checks if the current user has read permissions, throwing a ForbiddenException if not.

classes.name: EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule
classes.description: Defines a validation rule for verifying if a user has read permissions for a specified employee data group, based on roles and permissions managed via traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the specific data group name for which permissions will be validated.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the permission check for reading the specified data group. Throws ForbiddenException if the user lacks permission.
